name: prettier-after-edit
description: Format files edited by Codex with Prettier after each change.

interface.longDescription: This plugin processes only files reported by supported Codex edit events. It formats supported files with project-local-first Prettier, retains PATH fallback, and reports changed, unchanged, skipped, and failed outcomes distinctly.
capabilities: Per-event exact-file Prettier formatting with truthful change status
Project-local tool preference with PATH fallback
defaultPrompt: Use Prettier After Edit to format changed files after supported Codex edits.
